scope.purpose: Bind the existing portable package producer to the final selected B0/B1 states and the Agent2 restore gate.

producer.assembly_note: There is no separate build subcommand. The actual package is assembled from the frozen skeleton with the existing metadata/identity/selection/prediction commands below; no producer code change is needed.

descriptor_shapes.both: Use package-relative paths and keep immutable_after_selection=true.

frozen_config_overrides.methods: Copy the same selected_step, model_id, state_path, and loader_kwargs values as the package_manifest overrides; retain the fixed decoder/readout geometry and package-relative paths.

commands.purpose: Copy the two selected states and the already verified public E as regular files into the persistent primary package.
commands.precondition: Define guarded_copy_function in the shell prologue before this step.

commands.purpose: Create canonical tensor-identity sidecars with the existing producer.
commands.command: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/trr0012_package.py identity --input "$P/states/current_fixed.safetensors" --output "$P/identity/current_fixed.safetensors.json" && env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/trr0012_package.py identity --input "$P/states/expanded_fixed.safetensors" --output "$P/identity/expanded_fixed.safetensors.json" && env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/trr0012_package.py identity --input "$P/readout/public_normalized_embeddings.safetensors" --output "$P/identity/public_normalized_embeddings.safetensors.json"

commands.purpose: Create the explicit complete-before-smoke selection receipt from the two fit bindings.
commands.command: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/trr0012_package.py selection-receipt --b0-state <B0_SELECTED_STATE> --b1-state <B1_SELECTED_STATE> --b0-binding experiments/TRR-0012/package/B0_selection_binding.json --b1-binding <B1_FIT_BINDING_JSON> --output "$P/receipts/selection_complete_before_smoke.json" --development-labels-used true

commands.purpose: Materialize the two create-only final descriptors from config_template; do not add fields or substitute old state metadata.
commands.command: test ! -e "$P/package_manifest.json" && test ! -L "$P/package_manifest.json" || { echo "package_manifest.json already exists; preserve and inspect the prior attempt" >&2; exit 1; }; install -m 0444 experiments/TRR-0012/package/package_manifest_template_v1.json "$P/package_manifest.json"; test ! -e "$P/config/frozen_config.json" && test ! -L "$P/config/frozen_config.json" || { echo "frozen_config.json already exists; preserve and inspect the prior attempt" >&2; exit 1; }; install -m 0444 "$P/config/decoder.json" "$P/config/frozen_config.json"; apply the package_manifest_overrides and frozen_config_overrides in this receipt atomically
commands.precondition: The two final descriptors must be absent; failed attempts are retained rather than overwritten.

commands.purpose: Generate the two-method expected smoke output and its sibling receipt after ordinary selection.
commands.command: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 "$P/code/trr0012_package.py" predict --package-root "$P" --observations "$P/smoke/public_base_first2.safetensors" --output "$P/smoke/expected_predictions.safetensors" --receipt "$P/smoke/expected_predictions.receipt.json" --device <qualified-device>

commands.purpose: Bind actual component bytes/hashes and the four derived smoke prediction records in the external producer contract, then validate metadata/path/hash closure.
commands.command: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/trr0012_package.py validate --manifest experiments/TRR-0012/package/contract_v1.json --package-root "$P"

guarded_copy_policy.destination_existing_regular_file: accept only when its SHA-256 equals the source SHA-256; never replace it
guarded_copy_policy.destination_existing_symlink_or_mismatch: fail closed and preserve the existing attempt

build_command_template.guarded_copy_function: copy_or_verify() { src="$1"; dst="$2"; test -f "$src" && test ! -L "$src" || { echo "invalid source: $src" >&2; return 1; }; if test -e "$dst" || test -L "$dst"; then test ! -L "$dst" || { echo "destination is symlink: $dst" >&2; return 1; }; test "$(sha256sum "$src" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum "$dst" | awk '{print $1}')" || { echo "destination hash differs: $dst" >&2; return 1; }; return 0; fi; install -m 0444 "$src" "$dst"; }

nested_receipt_cli.default_receipt_rule: If --receipt is omitted, output.with_suffix('.receipt.json') is created beside the prediction output.
contract_checks_verified_by_source: receipt is a sibling of the output with the required .receipt.json suffix
selection receipt is required and must record complete_before_smoke=true
state_file_binding is recorded for both current_fixed and expanded_fixed
readout.file_binding records the loaded public E
observations records aggregate tensor digests and ordered four-row slots
runtime records Python, dependency, device, and package-relative imported module bindings
nested_receipt_cli.agent2_gate_alignment: P11 restore_gate.py requires the CLI sibling receipt at consumer.receipt_relative_path and verifies its actual loaded paths, file hashes, observations, methods, runtime, and exact smoke predictions.

required_sequence: ordinary B0/B1 checkpoint selection is complete
primary package is measured and under the 2 GiB cap
root copies the complete primary bundle to /mnt/c/Users/alanz/Token-Reconstruction-Backups/TRR-0012
Agent2 validates the two copies and materializes a clean persistent runtime
Agent2 runs the real restore gate and exact four-row/two-method smoke comparison
